## What's new
- **Offline mode** – a new **Network** card in **⚙ Settings** (or `ARRHUB_OFFLINE=true`). ArrHub then talks only to your own services:
  - no update check on GitHub (the About card says the check is off)
  - no images from TMDB/TVDB – posters and backgrounds come only from Radarr and Sonarr (MediaCover), request posters from Seerr's image cache
  - in the **Add** tab, movie posters are loaded through ArrHub via Seerr instead of straight from TMDB in the browser; without a local source a placeholder is shown
  - a guard refuses any connection that isn't to one of your configured services

## Improvements
- **Seerr request posters are local-first** – also with offline mode off, posters now come from Seerr's image proxy/cache (`/imageproxy`, Seerr/Jellyseerr and Overseerr) and only fall back to TMDB if that fails.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.11.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.10.3...v1.11.0
